Olivia Park: Quick postmortem follow-up: want to lock owners for profiling, jemalloc tuning, compaction prototype, alert changes, and CI leak checks. Short notes here.
Daniel Zhou: I'll own the repro + heap snapshots. Plan: nightly heap-snap retention for 7 days, jemalloc arena stats, and a churn_runner that skews small/large object mixes. ETA 48h for first artifacts.
Hannah Lee: Runtime will take compaction and runtime guards. Proposal: feature-flagged incremental compactor + per-shard soft_limit that rejects writes with 429 and emits structured dump. ETA 12 days for prototype.
Olivia Park: Action items:
 - Daniel: reproducible harness + first week of heapshots (ETA 2d)
 - Hannah: compactor PR + soft_limit flag (ETA 12d)
 - Tom B. (observability): add frag-heatmap, per-shard resident, and 429 counters, alert at host_resident>82% (ETA 4d)
 - ops-bot: schedule canary at 5% post-merge
Daniel Zhou: Repro notes: churn_runner example:
./tools/churn --shards=60 --sizes=64,8192 --ttl=45 --duration=120
curl http://localhost:9100/debug/je_stats > /tmp/je.json
ci-bot: Add leak-sanitizer job to CI once repro PR lands.
Hannah Lee: Mitigation details: start with low-CPU incremental page migration; if ineffective, evaluate slab-coalesce. Also experiment with jemalloc arena purge during idle windows.
Olivia Park: Rollout: dev -> canary 5% for 2h -> ramp 25% then 60% if frag delta <2% and p95 stable. Abort criteria: write rejections >0.8% or median latency regresses >10ms.
Daniel Zhou: Found an early-return path in snapshot builder. Adding unit test + sanitizer run in CI. PR will reference postmortem.
Hannah Lee: Also adding a hard_guard: if host resident > hard_limit, throttle and write dumps for offline analysis. Runtime owns this.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled after runtime PR merges; will post start/finish notices.
Olivia Park: Weekly check-ins for 6 weeks, Mondays 9am, Hannah to send invites. Update the postmortem checklist with PR links and set status to in-progress when started. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
